summary: Prepare positions, plan concessions, and document commercial agreements. Explore this five-day contract negotiation course.
lede: Contract negotiation is the structured work of preparing positions and reaching workable agreement on commercial terms. For contract professionals, procurement specialists, commercial managers and project leads, the course applies BATNA and ZOPA analysis to prioritise issues, plan conditional concessions, assess counteroffers and document agreed terms.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who prepare or negotiate commercial agreements, manage contract positions, or advise decision-makers on terms, concessions, and approval limits.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with commercial contracts or prior involvement in supplier, customer, or project negotiations is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
